title: Hiring: Sales Executive – Healthcare Software (Medlyx)
description:
We’re looking for driven sales professionals in Kolkata to introduce Medlyx, our healthcare software, to doctors, clinics, and hospitals. If you’re a Medical Representative (MR) or dynamic sales experienced in software and medical field, looking to move into the fast-growing healthcare technology space, this role is for you.

**What you’ll do**

* Visit doctors, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, and hospitals across Kolkata to present and demonstrate Medlyx
* Generate leads, follow up, and close sales to meet monthly targets
* Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals
* Coordinate with our product and support team for onboarding and client success
* Share market feedback to help us improve the product

**Who we’re looking for**

* 1–10 years of experience as an MR or in healthcare/pharma field sales (software sales experience is a plus)
* An existing network of doctors and clinics in Kolkata
* Good communication skills in Bengali, Hindi, and English
* Comfortable with basic technology and product demos (training will be provided)
* Own two-wheeler preferred
* Graduate or MBA in any discipline

Send your CV to support@medlyx.in with the subject “Medlyx Sales – Kolkata”

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Hiring: Voice Sales Associate – Restaurant Partnerships & Digital Advertising
description:
**Hiring: Voice Sales Associate – Restaurant Partnerships & Digital Advertising**

**Job Location**: College More, Sector V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata, West Bengal

**Job Type**: Full-Time | Work From Office

**Department**: Sales / Telecalling / Business Development

**Salary: Up to ₹16,000 CTC per month + Attractive Sales Incentives**

**Working Hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM**

**Weekly Off: Sunday (Fixed)**

**About the Role**

Are you confident in English communication and passionate about sales, business development, and building client relationships?

Hiring enthusiastic and target-driven **Voice Sales Associates** for a leading food delivery and restaurant technology platform.

In this role, you will connect with restaurant owners and business partners, help them onboard their restaurants onto a popular online food ordering platform, and introduce them to digital advertising solutions that can improve their visibility, reach more customers, and grow their business.

This is an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to build a career in **B2B Sales, Telesales, Restaurant Partnerships, Digital Advertising Sales, and Business Development**, with opportunities for career advancement through internal job postings (IJP) and promotions based on performance and organizational requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

* **Restaurant Onboarding:** Contact restaurant owners and prospective business partners through outbound sales calls and explain the benefits of joining a leading food delivery platform.
* **B2B Sales:** Identify potential restaurant partners, generate business opportunities, and convert prospects into active partners.
* **Digital Advertising Sales:** Promote advertising and paid visibility solutions to restaurant partners to help them increase their reach and attract more customers.
* **Upselling & Cross-Selling:** Understand restaurant partners' business needs and recommend suitable advertising and promotional solutions.
* **Lead Generation & Follow-Ups:** Maintain regular communication with prospective clients, follow up on leads, address queries, and close sales.
* **Target Achievement:** Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while maintaining quality standards.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Build strong relationships with restaurant owners and provide a professional experience throughout the sales process.
* **Sales Reporting:** Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales activities, follow-ups, and conversions.

**Eligibility Criteria:-**

* **Minimum Qualification:** 12th Pass or above.
* **Age Criteria:** 18–30 years.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent English communication skills with strong grammar, fluency, and clarity.
* **Sales Experience:** Prior experience in telesales, outbound sales, B2B sales, telemarketing, customer acquisition, or business development is preferred.
* **Freshers:** Candidates with excellent English communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also apply, subject to the hiring requirements.
* **Sales Mindset:** Ability to persuade customers, handle objections, negotiate effectively, and achieve sales targets.
* **Professionalism:** Confident verbal communication with clear pronunciation and the ability to conduct professional sales conversations.

**Benefits:-**

* **Salary:** Up to ₹16,000 CTC per month.
* **Performance Incentives:** Additional sales incentives based on the applicable incentive structure and performance.
* **Internal Job Postings (IJP):** Opportunities to apply for eligible internal vacancies across the organization within 6 months
* **Performance-Based Growth:** Strong performers may be considered for increased compensation and career advancement.
* **Leadership Opportunities:** Potential career progression into senior sales, team leadership, and other business roles, depending on performance, eligibility, and available vacancies.
* **Skill Development:** Gain practical experience in B2B sales, client acquisition, restaurant partnerships, upselling, and digital advertising.
* **Incentive Opportunities:** Earn additional incentives through successful sales and achievement of applicable targets.

If you are ambitious, results-oriented, and eager to grow in the sales industry, this opportunity can help you develop valuable skills and build a long-term career.

Who Should Apply?

This position is suitable for candidates searching for opportunities such as:

* Voice Sales Associate
* Sales Executive
* Telesales Executive
* Telecaller – Outbound Sales
* B2B Sales Executive
* Business Development Executive
* Restaurant Onboarding Executive
* Client Acquisition Executive
* Digital Advertising Sales Executive
* Inside Sales Executive

Candidates with experience in sales, Client acquisition, merchant onboarding, digital marketing sales or advertising upselling will find this role comfortable

**How to Apply:-**

Interested candidates who meet the eligibility criteria are encouraged to apply through Indeed..

**Apply now and explore your potential in sales and business development.**

Pay: ₹14,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have any experience in sales?

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

description:

City: Kolkata

State/Province: West Bengal

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to source and hire the right talent against the requirements shared by the business and ensuring a positive employer brand experience for the candidate throughout the hiring process.

**͏**
-----

**Do**

1. Hire the required talent from the different sourcing channels

* Understand business projections and urgency of talent requirements across order and cadre demands, skill type (type A/B/C), volume vs. niche etc.
* As per the talent requirements shared by the business, Create sourcing plan as per hiring channel mix and cost considerations
* Utilize job portals, consultants, employee referral to find the right fit from the industry/ within Wipro
* For the shortlisted candidates, facilitate the selection process with the technical panel
* As per the requirement by the business, facilitate different selection tests like technical programming language skills
* Conduct HR evaluation round and negotiate with the candidate(s) on the salary, position etc
* Take necessary approval from the tower lead/ head ensuring, hiring is strictly as per Wipro s salary range, minimizing exceptions to meet average cost per candidate target
* Formally roll out the job offer to the selected candidate(s) and coordinate with him/ her for offer acceptance
* Motivate, engage and maintain relationship with the selected candidate(s) from time to time till their joining
* Coordinate with the HRSS team for background verification of the selected candidate
* Communicate with Business Teams and Managers to from time to time on the status of joining etc

**͏**
-----

2. Manage Candidate Experience throughout the recruitment process

* Conduct candidate connect and pre-hiring candidate engagement activities to ensure healthy joining ratio
* Adherence to Wipro guidelines, processes and protocols with respect to responsiveness, clarity, compensation structure, SLAs, quality and auditability in all candidate communication, and deliver Zero valid escalation on hiring process
* Resolve candidate concerns and manage candidate escalations, turnaround slightest negative experience
* Daily maintain the data on the recruitment tool (Synergy) and upload all the candidate documents from time to time
* Ensure the weekly/ monthly/quarterly dashboards are updated and readily available for the management review
* Conduct meetings with WMG teams to update on the progress, risk and issues involved in hiring for a position and seek help if necessary
* Follow checks and balances placed by the recruitment team and conduct regular reviews with the management to ensure reliability, quality and integrity of recruitment data in the system

Bajaj Life Insurance Ltd. Location: Ecospace,new town,kolkata (On site)

Bajaj Life Insurance Ltd. is one of India’s leading private life insurance companies. A joint venture between Bajaj We are committed to transforming the life insurance landscape through digital innovation, customer\-centric solutions, and a high\-performance workforce.

Job Summary

We are seeking a results\-driven Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end recruitment for front\-line sales executive roles, agency channels, financial consultants, and operational teams. You will play a critical role in scaling our workforce, sourcing quality talent, and maintaining seamless candidate engagement.

High\-Volume Sourcing: Proactively source candidates using job portals (Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri), local referral channels, social media, and walk\-in drives.

Agent \& Agency Channel Onboarding: Support the recruitment and documentation process for Insurance Consultants and Agency Partners across branches. Screening \& Shortlisting: Evaluate candidate fit based on sales aptitude, communication skills, and financial domain knowledge. Data Management \& Reporting: Track daily recruitment metrics, update internal databases, and submit hiring pipelines to regional leads.

Key Requirements Experience: Experience \& fresher both can apply for the position (OJT provided)

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Any Stream; MBA/PGDM in HR is a plus. Skills: Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Strong ability to manage target\-driven recruitment quotas.

Tools: Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and hands\-on experience with Job Portals and ATS platforms.
